description: This file defines the Layout class within the Opencart Catalog Model Design namespace. It contains methods for retrieving layout information and modules related to layouts in the OpenCart platform.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing layout data, including retrieving layout IDs based on routes and fetching associated modules.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout ID associated with a specific route; defaults to 0 if none is found.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns an array of modules assigned to a particular layout and position.
